SeeComics Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-11-05

Developer: 梵虚

SeeComics is a local-first comic and novel reader. Core reading requires no account, and files you select are processed primarily on your device.

Information we process

When you import locally, the app reads only the RAR, CBR, ZIP, CBZ, images, PDF, TXT, or DRM-free EPUB you select. It stores a reading copy, cover, title and volume metadata, reading position, bookmarks, and display preferences in the app's private storage.

SeeComics contains no advertising, behavioral analytics, or cross-app tracking, and it operates no first-party account or cloud-sync service.

Third-party cloud import

Third-party cloud drives are optional file sources, subject to the entry points and configuration on your platform. Only after you connect and authorize a provider does the app use its sign-in page, system service or official SDK to browse folders and download selected files. SeeComics business code does not read account passwords. Provider terms and privacy policies govern the service and its data handling.

The provider's consent screen defines the requested access. This may allow reading folders and drive files, not just one selected file. SeeComics uses it only for your browsing and selected downloads, with no automatic crawling or syncing of the entire drive, and no cloud uploads, modifications or deletions. Drive data is not used for advertising, sale or general-purpose AI training. Necessary metadata includes file identifiers, names, sizes, types, modification times, parent folders, download URLs and checksums.

Clients contact provider authorization and file APIs and their download endpoints directly. Providers or SDKs may process account identifiers, authorization records and connection/device information under their own policies. Downloads, necessary resume metadata and app-held tokens are saved locally. Platform credential protection secures the tokens; some platforms or services require authorization again after expiry.

Disconnect clears tokens saved by SeeComics. It does not delete imported library files, revoke the provider's authorization grant or sign out browser, system or SDK accounts. Revoke access in the provider's account/third-party app settings. Delete imported content separately from the library.

Local-network transfer

TV transfer uses a local address, one-time pairing code, and the selected file only during a session you start. The file travels directly over the same local network and is not relayed through a SeeComics server. Closing the session invalidates the pairing code.

Retention, deletion, and security

Imported content and reading records remain until you delete the title, clear app data, or uninstall. Private storage, transactional writes, and platform credential stores reduce accidental disclosure or corruption.

Deleting a title removes its reading copy, cover cache, progress, and bookmarks, but not the source file at its original location. Android release configuration explicitly excludes app content and tokens from backup.

If you choose to remember an archive password, it is encrypted in the system credential vault for reopening encrypted files in the selected series. Otherwise it is used only for the current unlock. Passwords are not written to ordinary preferences or diagnostic logs.

If you enable app access protection, the operating system performs biometric verification. SeeComics receives the result without reading or storing fingerprint or face templates. Protection preferences and hidden recent-reading entries remain on the device.

When you explicitly export reading presets or a library backup, the chosen destination stores the exported data. Temporary downloads and cover caches may also remain locally. Use storage management to clear relevant caches, or delete content and local backups.

Permissions, children, and choices

The app uses the system file picker, internet, and local-network access only when a feature needs them. It does not request contacts, precise location, camera, or microphone access.

SeeComics does not provide content directed to children; all displayed content is selected by the device user. You can stop local processing by deleting content, disconnecting Netdisk, or uninstalling. Support email: fanxu1218@hotmail.com

Questions and information you voluntarily send to the contact email are used to respond to and handle your request. Do not send passwords, authorization tokens, or unrelated private reading content.

Policy changes

We will update the date when features, third-party services, or legal requirements change this policy. Material changes will also be disclosed in the app or release notes.

Support email: fanxu1218@hotmail.com
